name: performance-test
description: Performance test definitions for OpenCRVS v2.x
author: Riku Rouvila <riku@opencrvs.org>

scripts.test:smoke: yarn build smoke && k6 run dist/smoke.js
scripts.test:smoke:cloud: yarn build smoke && export $(grep -v '^#' .env | xargs) && k6 run --out cloud dist/smoke.js
scripts.test:load: yarn build load && k6 run dist/load.js
scripts.test:load:cloud: yarn build load && export $(grep -v '^#' .env | xargs) && MAX_VUS=${MAX_VUS:-100} k6 run --out cloud dist/load.js
scripts.test:soak: yarn build soak && k6 run dist/soak.js
scripts.test:soak:cloud: yarn build soak && export $(grep -v '^#' .env | xargs) && k6 run --out cloud dist/soak.js
scripts.test:spike: yarn build spike && k6 run dist/spike.js
scripts.test:spike:cloud: yarn build spike && export $(grep -v '^#' .env | xargs) && k6 run --out cloud dist/spike.js
